text:
alex: Heads up — several customers reporting 502/gateway errors since the canary rollout (~05:08 UTC). Metrics show a sharp 5xx spike for /v1/generate in us-east-1.
infra-bot: Alert: 5xx rate increased 4.8x in us-east-1 for route /v1/generate. > https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/alerts/5xx-spike
support: Tickets from customers: #4231, #4234, #4239. Messages: \"generation returned 502 after ~8s\" and sample curl attached.
maria: i'm oncall, looking. @sahil which config/flag did the canary flip include? any selector changes?
sahil: Canary used new routing selector: route_tag_v2=true. Intended 5% traffic. Deployment report shows 15% because seed-release matrix combined selectors incorrectly.
lisa: I grabbed the canary pod labels and the rollout manifest diff — looks like a selector overlap with legacy "seed-release" binding.
lisa: ```
- selectors:
-   - match: {release: stable}
+ selectors:
+  - match: {release: stable}
+  - match: {route_tag_v2: "true"}  # introduced in canary
```
alex: repro curl from support (sanitized):
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw/gptx","input":"hello"}'
``` 
sample response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n{"error":"upstream returned 502"}\ntrace: tr-1a2b3c
infra-bot: Recent gateway logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T05:09:12Z] ERROR gateway.go:213 upstream returned 502: connection reset by peer trace_id=tr-1a2b3c upstream=svc-runtime-3
[2026-03-17T05:09:13Z] WARN  router.go:88 inconsistent selector match for pod runtime-ax12 (labels: route_tag_v2=true, release=stable)
```
maria: plan: immediate rollback of the canary selector to 0% and remove route_tag_v2 from selector set. sahil can you apply? kevin please stand by for shedder/rate-limit changes.
sahil: Applying rollback now — patching control-plane config. Command: 
```
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap route-selectors --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/data/route_tag_v2"}]'
# or
kubectl -n redwood apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: route-selectors
data:
  selectors: |-
    - match: {release: stable}
EOF
```
kevin: I'll temporarily throttle the canary tag and enable shedder: set route.quota.route_tag_v2=100qps and shedder.enabled=true to avoid cascade if any leftover pods match.
support: Sending proactive note to affected customers and attaching example traces. Will post an update on status.redwood.ai: "Investigating 502 errors affecting some customers in us-east-1".
billing-bot: No large billing anomalies detected for impacted tenants in last 30m, flagging for later review.
infra-bot: Rollback applied at 1769123690 (05:14 UTC). Re-evaluating metrics.
infra-bot: Update: 5xx rate back down to baseline in us-east-1 at 05:17 UTC (5 mins after rollback). CPU on runtime pods returned to normal.
alex: thanks everyone. Next actions: 1) postmortem scheduled, 2) add guard in rollout orchestrator to prevent selector overlap (reject canary when selectors intersect with stable), 3) add smoke test hitting /v1/generate for new selectors before rollouts. :thumbsup:
maria: assigning follow-up to eng-runtime and eng-oncall. I'll open the incident ticket and add timeline + customer impact.
support: we'll add customer follow-up templates and patch tickets.
kevin: leaving note — when re-rolling, coordinate quota bump and shedder off-ramp, and run a tiny incremental traffic replay test first.
alex: closing thread here, marking incident as mitigated."
